Example 2. Solve the equations
$x + 2y = 9$
$2x - y = 3$

Solution : The given equations are
$x + 2y = 9$ .........(1)
$2x - y = 3$ .........(2)

From (2) we get $y = 2x - 3$ .........(3)

Putting the value of $y$ in equation (1) we get, $x + 2(2x - 3) = 9$
or, $x + 4x - 6 = 9$
or, $5x = 6 + 9$
or, $5x = 15$
or, $x = \frac{15}{5}$
$\therefore x = 3$

Now putting the value of $x$ in (3) we get,
$y = 2 \times 3 - 3$
$= 6 - 3$
$= 3$

$\therefore$ Required solution : $(x, y) = (3, 3)$.
